anatomy.flutter: AspectRatio({ratio, margin = EdgeInsets.zero, child}) is a single StatelessWidget wrapping stock flutter.AspectRatio(aspectRatio: ratio, child: margin==zero ? child : Padding(padding: margin, child: child)) -- one box, no two-box split.
anatomy.web: AspectRatio is an 11-line wrapper: `<AspectRatioPrimitive.Root data-slot="aspect-ratio" {...props} />` from Radix, which renders an outer flow box sized by percentage padding-bottom and an inner absolutely-positioned box the caller's classes land on.

api.flutter: Constructor takes `ratio` (double, width/height, same convention CSS uses), `margin` (EdgeInsets, default zero) applied on the inner box via Padding, and `child`.
api.web: Radix's AspectRatioPrimitive.Root takes a CSS `ratio` prop (via style, not shown here) and spreads arbitrary props/className onto the inner absolutely-positioned box; no `margin` concept -- a caller adds a Tailwind margin class directly (e.g. `mb-4` on the carousel card).
api.note: The web has no first-class `margin` prop because it does not need one -- any Tailwind margin utility on the child does the job, landing on the inner absolutely-positioned box the way CSS margins on an absolutely positioned box always do. Flutter has no equivalent to 'just add a class', so the port had to expose `margin` explicitly as a parameter and reproduce the two-box shrink behaviour by hand (Padding inside AspectRatio rather than a sibling margin). This is the right per-platform answer to the same visual contract, not a missing feature.

states.flutter: AspectRatio is a StatelessWidget with no interaction of its own; it only sizes whatever `child` is passed.
states.web: AspectRatioPrimitive.Root renders a plain, non-interactive positioning div; no pseudo-classes or state attributes are declared on it.
states.note: Aspect-ratio is a layout primitive on both platforms and carries no interaction/state matrix of its own -- any interactivity belongs to the child it wraps.

disabled.flutter: No disabled concept exists on AspectRatio; it has no onPressed-style entry point to disable.
disabled.web: No disabled prop, data-disabled attribute, or aria-disabled hook exists on AspectRatioPrimitive.Root.
disabled.note: A pure sizing wrapper has nothing to disable on either platform.

interaction.flutter: No pointer, keyboard, or focus handling is declared -- the widget only participates in layout via flutter.AspectRatio's own sizing algorithm.
interaction.web: Renders one <div> with no event handlers and no tabIndex; all interaction is delegated entirely to whatever content the caller places inside it.
interaction.note: Neither side gives this primitive any interaction contract to audit; it is geometry only.

semantics.flutter: No Semantics node of its own is added -- the widget forwards straight through to `child`, so whatever accessible role/name the child carries is exactly what a screen reader sees; AspectRatio contributes nothing to announce.
semantics.web: Radix's AspectRatioPrimitive.Root renders a bare positioning div with no ARIA role or label of its own, deferring entirely to its children's semantics.
semantics.note: Transparent-to-accessibility-tree behaviour matches on both sides; there is no target-size concern either since the box is sized by its content/ratio, not tappable.
